svg.title: How you work with author-skills
svg.desc: Five steps: set up once with /setup-novel; build characters and places with /build-character and /build-world; write, which only you do; revise with /scene-breaks, /echoes and /proofread; check continuity with /check-continuity. Then again, chapter by chapter. When stuck: /brainstorm when an idea won't take shape, /muse when there is no idea yet.
